responseText:
Thanks — I can do that. Below is an updated invite draft I suggest. Tell me any changes (date/time/attendees/conference link/attachments), or reply "OK — send update" and I will update the calendar event and send the update to attendees.

Polished invite (placeholders in [brackets] — I'll fill them if you want me to):

Subject:
Customer Advisory Board — [Quarter] Meeting — [Day, Month DD] • [Time] [TZ]

Body:
Hi all,

Thank you for participating in the Customer Advisory Board. Our next meeting is scheduled for [Day, Month DD] at [Time] [Timezone]. We’ve updated the agenda and logistics below — please review and RSVP.

Agenda (60 minutes)
- 5 min — Welcome & brief introductions
- 15 min — Product roadmap highlights and key milestones (Product Lead)
- 20 min — Deep dive: [Feature / Topic] — customer feedback requested
- 15 min — Open discussion: prioritize needs & questions
- 5 min — Next steps & action owners

Logistics
- Duration: [60 minutes] (adjustable)
- Location: [Video link + dial-in] / [Physical location]
- Materials: [link to deck / attached agenda]
- RSVP by: [Date]
- Please reply with any topics you’d like added to the agenda.

We appreciate your time and input — looking forward to the conversation.

Thanks,
[Your name]
[Title, Company]
[Contact info / scheduling assistant link]

Required confirmations before I update/send
- Use the existing calendar event or create a new one?
- Confirm final date, time, timezone, and duration
- Confirm attendees (use current attendee list or provide updates)
- Conferencing link / location to include (or should I generate a meeting link?)
- Attachments or deck to include (link or file)
- RSVP deadline (if different from above)
- Any additional notes (confidentiality, recording notice, follow-up survey, etc.)

If you say “OK — send update” and don’t specify otherwise, I will:
- Use the existing event (if one exists) and existing attendee list
- Insert the draft text above (filling placeholders with the event’s date/time)
- Attach a short agenda PDF (I’ll generate it unless you want to provide a file)
- Send the update to all attendees and add a reminder 24 hours before

Which option do you want? If you want me to proceed now, reply with:
- “OK — send update” (and any specifics above), or
- any changes you’d like to the draft.
